description: This file defines a class 'DeploymentRequestProcessor' that manages deployment requests to GitHub, including creating deployment requests, handling environment naming, and determining deployment steps based on configuration.

classes.name: DeploymentRequestProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for processing deployment steps and creating deployment requests via GitHub API.

methods.name: processDeploymentStep
methods.description: Processes a deployment step, creates a deployment request via GitHub API, and returns the deployment response.

methods.name: getEnvironmentNameFromParts
methods.description: Constructs environment name by combining environment name and step name.

methods.name: getEnvironmentName
methods.description: Gets the environment name for a specific step index within a deployment configuration.

methods.name: shouldDeploy
methods.description: Determines if a deployment should proceed for a given step based on environment configuration.

methods.name: getPreviousEnvironmentName
methods.description: Finds the previous non-empty environment name in the environment steps list.
